system_name: SupeRR Selector Season 2 War Room Analytics Engine

reconciliation.audit_note: 883 matches were scheduled across IPL and T20Is from 2022 to 2026. Exactly 16 matches were abandoned without a ball bowled due to inclement weather/rain. 867 contested matches produced 200,999 valid deliveries.

metrics_coverage.wpa_disclosure: WPA is modeled on all 2nd-innings chasing states (95,272 deliveries, 47.4% of total balls) using a calibrated logistic regression (AUC=0.8966). First-innings deliveries are excluded from chase WPA and evaluated via crisis collapse and death par benchmarks. All WPA metrics displayed in player rankings use the chase-delivery denominator to ensure zero distortion.
